1.explanation:
This minimal React application uses the Carbon DatePicker component (v10.42.0). It renders a single-date picker with a calendar icon. To reproduce the bug:

1. Run the app.
2. Click the calendar icon at the right end of the input to open the datepicker.
3. Press any Arrow key — you will observe that the date grid does not move the focus cell.

Next, refresh and instead click inside the text input to open the picker. Now focus is placed in the calendar, and the Arrow keys will navigate the dates as expected. This reproduces the accessibility regression described in the bug report.
1.bug_scenario: When you render a Carbon React <DatePicker> of type “single” and open its calendar panel by clicking the calendar icon button, the focus is left on the icon and the calendar grid will not respond to Arrow keys. If instead you open the calendar by clicking directly in the input field, focus moves into the calendar grid and the Arrow keys work correctly.
